articles.title: Batman: Knightfall Part 1 Is Now Available to Watch Online
articles.summary: The latest Batman movie is now available to buy digitally. Knightfall Part 1 is a direct-to-video animated DC movie, but that doesn't mean it isn't an excellent take on the Caped Crusader. We loved it enough to award it an impressive 9 out of 10 in our review.
body: Batman: Knightfall Part 1 - Knightfall is the start of a new trilogy of animated Batman films. It's based on one of the best Batman graphic novels of all time and is absolutely worth checking out.

Knightfall Part 1 isn't available in theaters, so buying the movie digitally through a VOD service like Prime Video is your only option if you want to watch it right now. If you don't mind waiting until September 8, however, there's a 4K UHD and Blu-ray you can preorder for a bit more money.

With the first part of the trilogy out now, you're likely wondering when exactly you can expect the second part to drop. While we don't have a hard release date for Knightfall Part 2 just yet, we do know that it's supposed to arrive sometime later in 2026. The final entry in the trilogy has been confirmed for early 2027 as well.

As for new live-action Batman movies, you're going to have to wait even longer still. The Batman: Part 2 was pushed back to 2028 and we still don't have a release date for James Gunn's The Brave and the Bold.
points: The latest Batman movie is now available to buy digitally.
Knightfall Part 1 is a direct-to-video animated DC movie, but that doesn't mean it isn't an excellent take on the Caped Crusader.

articles.title: Newegg Has the Least Overpriced 32GB of DDR5 6000MHz CL 30 Desktop Memory
articles.summary: RAM is expensive and there's no way of getting around it. If you're going to upgrade your existing memory or build a PC from scratch, you just have to accept the fact that your budget needs to accommodate for today's RAM prices. Still not fazed?
body: For a limited time, you can pick up 32GB (2x16GB) of the V-COLOR Manta XSky DDR5-6000MHz CL30 Desktop Memory for $369.59 with free shipping. You'll need to be signed into your AliExpress account and then click on the link to see the pricing. If the page says it's not available for shipping, reload a couple of times (sometimes it's actually out of stock, sometimes it's just a glitch). If you buy it directly from Newegg's site, you're going to pay $420 for the same RAM.

V-COLOR is a well known memory brand. The Manta XSky DDR5 RAM in particular uses SK Hynix ICs, which are considered one of the best memory chips you can get. The RAM is meant for AMD systems (although it could work with Intel) since it's preloaded with an AMD EXPO overclocking profile and not Intel XMP. The rated speed of 6,000MHz and CAS latency of 30 is considered the sweet spot for AMD CPUs. Unless you're going after benchmark leaderboards (and hve a LOT of disposable cash), RAM with higher speeds and lower memory latencies are wasted on gaming builds.
Is it better to wait for RAM to go down in price? Unless you're willing to wait a few years, probably not.
points: RAM is expensive and there's no way of getting around it.
If you're going to upgrade your existing memory or build a PC from scratch, you just have to accept the fact that your budget needs to accommodate for today's RAM prices.

articles.title: Tim Burton's Forgotten 10/10 Fantasy Masterpiece is Officially Free to Watch on Streaming
articles.summary: In conversations about Tim Burton ’s greatest movies, Beetlejuice always comes up towards the top. So do his Batman movies, Edward Scissorhands, Ed Wood, and Pee-Wee’s Big Adventure.
body: Big Fish is the story of Will Bloom (Billy Crudup), a man looking to reconnect with his semi-estranged father, Edward Bloom (Albert Finney), who is on his deathbed. The film mostly consists of a series of flashbacks depicting the extraordinary adventures of the younger Edward Bloom ( Ewan McGregor ). He claims to have met an 11-foot-tall giant and a pair of conjoined twin singers, and that he once caught a seven-foot-long catfish. The son, having heard all the stories before, remains deeply skeptical. He’s also weary of his dad’s tall tales and wants to truly get to know his father before it’s too late.

If I were to use one word to describe Big Fish, I would probably say it’s “charming.” So much of that feeling comes from the natural charisma of the two guys playing Edward Bloom. What’s especially remarkable is they are completely convincing as the same character, despite the fact that the actors don't really look like each other, nor do they use their considerable charm in the same way.

articles.summary: Looking for a powerful ebike with the speed and range to meet your ambitious needs? Nowadays you can find a decent ebike for well under $500. As part of a new Back to School Sale, AliExpress has the UrLife E20 750W 48V Electric Bike for $275.67 after you apply $50 off coupon code " JJX50B ".
body: The UrLife E20 is an adult electric bike featuring a 750W (1,000W peak) motor that can get up to speeds of 28mph. Unlike most bikes in this price range that use a 36V battery, the E20 includes a powerful 48V battery which offer more power, acceleration, and torque, perfect for tackling steep hills. The 13Ah battery offers up to 80 miles of range under ideal conditions. The actual distance is dependent on other factors like your speed, terrain, elevation, and so forth. It's also removable in case you want to store the battery in a separate location from the bike.

The frame is made of carbon steel so it's on the heavier side at about 60 pounds, but it also has a decent weight capacity of 265 pounds. It's equipped with 20" fat tires with front fork shock-absorbing suspension, which makes it better suited for unpaved terrain compared to other bikes at this price.

articles.title: The Witcher 3 Songs of the Past Expansion Confirmed to Include More Gwent, and Everyone Is Already Celebrating
articles.summary: CD Projekt Red has confirmed The Witcher 3: Wild Hunt 's upcoming Songs of the Past expansion will come with more Gwent, and card game lovers are already celebrating. The Witcher 3 earned a lot of praise when it launched back in 2015.
body: "In Gwent, gamers clash with friends in fast-paced duels that combine skill-based play with bluffing, and careful deck construction," an official description from CD Projekt Red says. "The game is played over a best-of-three series of rounds, as players unleash their hand by slinging spells and diverse units with special abilities, and use clever tricks to deceive their opponents."

CD Projekt Red's in-universe card game first launched within the third installment in its Witcher series before being transformed into a standalone spinoff in 2017 and a real-life tabletop experience in 2025. It's a formula others have unsuccessfully attempted to mimic, but few have managed to stand the test of time quite like Gwent. That's probably exactly why it will be making a comeback when the developer returns to The Witcher 3 with its Songs of the Past expansion in 2027.

CD Projekt Red community and social media manager Marcin Łukaszewski teased the return of the fan-favorite side activity when replying to a player on X/Twitter. When the fan said they hoped more Gwent would be included in the surprise expansion, Łukaszewski offered a simple reply: "Confirmed!"

articles.title: The Duskbloods Playtest Was Even More Popular Than Elden Ring Nightreign’s
articles.summary: It sounds like fans were eager to learn everything they could about From Software's The Duskbloods, as one of the game's producers has revealed the Switch 2 exclusive saw higher playtest sign-ups compared to Elden Ring Nightreign.
body: Speaking during a livestream hosted by Japanese gaming publication Famitsu (and translated by GamesRadar+ ), From Software producer Yasuhiro Kitao stated the number of applications for The Duskbloods playtest eclipsed that of the developer's previous multiplayer experiment.

Given that Elden Ring Nightreign's playtest was available on PlayStation 5 and Xbox Series X|S (the full game was also available on PC and last-gen consoles) the fact that The Duskbloods received more interest on Switch 2 sounds like it should be impossible. The Switch 2 is also a relatively new console, having only been available for around a year, meaning its user base is much smaller compared to that of the other two consoles.

While it is surprising on the surface, perhaps there is some logic to be deciphered here. Elden Ring Nightreign went on to sell more than 5 million copies, with its DLC alone selling 2 million copies in under a week. The game's popularity and success proved From Software could make a wildly fun, multiplayer-focused souls-like, perhaps generating more interest for The Duskbloods.

articles.title: Akira Officially Returns to Theaters in IMAX and 4K for One Day Only
articles.summary: If you missed the 4K remaster of Akira in theaters when it debuted in 2020, you have a second shot this summer. Katsuhiro Otomo's landmark anime movie will return to theaters — for one day only — in 4K and IMAX format in September.
body: Akira will be rereleased in 4K and IMAX in the United States and Canada on Sept. 4, distributed by Crunchyroll and Sony Pictures Entertainment. The showings of Otomo's cyberpunk classic will be presented both in the original Japanese with English subtitles and in an English dub.

Originally released in 1988, Akira tells the story of Tokyo in the distant future of 2019, 31 years after the destruction of the metropolis. The animated epic, based on Otomo's manga of the same name, focuses on Kaneda, the leader of a biker gang whose childhood friend, Tetsuo Shima, acquires powerful telekinetic abilities after a near-fatal accident.
Tickets for the Akira release are available from the IMAX website and Fandango.

articles.title: I Can’t Believe I Missed Mortal Shell 2’s Best Item, Silly Me
articles.summary: From awesome Tarstones to exceptional weapons, there are a lot of really good items to find in Mortal Shell 2. While you can miss them if you're not doing your due diligence while exploring, there's an early-game item that you really don't want to miss because of how it trivializes most fights.
body: The first boss you fight happens in the prologue. After some light exploration and acquiring your first shell, Haros, you roll up on the Tar Golem, who absolutely wrecks your stuff. It's designed as a forced loss, so actually putting up a fight is pointless, especially since a cutscene plays showing that Haros saves your life anyway.

It's here that you loot your now-dead shell for the Vatra's Seal, which hardens your body to nullify incoming damage and freezes you mid-animation. It's actually a pretty overpowered seal. Not only does it cancel out damage, causing enemies to get knocked back if they attack your shell, but it also acts as an animation cancel, letting you interrupt your attacks by hardening your body to guard. Time the harden just right and you've got a perfect parry, which deals massive posture damage and eventually leads to a counterattack.

Vatra's Seal is essentially the main ability from the first Mortal Shell. But instead of it being tied to one specific shell, when you loot Haros' corpse in the sequel, you can harden your body no matter which shell you currently have equipped. It rules.

articles.title: 41 Years, the Most Inventive Sci-Fi Thriller of the '80s Is Officially Free to Watch on Streaming
articles.summary: Zombies are some of the most difficult creatures to innovate. Over nearly a century of cinematic history, these monsters have typically been frightening but simple; they eat brains and they decompose.
body: But 41 years ago one movie blazed the way for undead innovation. It led to a breed of zombie that, despite being frightening and deadly, also had the capacity for depth. Re-Animator redefined the genre forever, and it’s streaming for free on Tubi.

Directed by experimental sci-fi icon Stuart Gordon and released in 1985, Re-Animator is a modern take on Frankenstein by way of horror master H.P. Lovecraft. The story follows Herbert West (Gordon's frequent collaborator Jeffrey Combs), who has developed a green serum that can bring dead beings back to life. Of course, West's experiments quickly get out of hand, leading to a disturbing grand finale. The movie became a cult classic thanks to its grind-house thrills and unintentionally campy comedy, resulting in two lesser sequels.

articles.title: Call Of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 Is Way Ahead Of Black Ops 7 Already By One Metric
articles.summary: Call of Duty: Modern Warfare 4 is nearing 400,000 copies sold on Steam already, and that's well ahead of where last year's Black Ops 7 stood at launch on Valve's platform.
body: Elliott said Black Ops 7 managed to hit around 200,000 copies pre-sold on Steam by launch. Modern Warfare 4 has doubled that, and with two months still to go before release.

MW4's beta put up big numbers on Steam during its early-access period, reaching a peak of more than 115,000 concurrent users. Black Ops 7, meanwhile, peaked at about 100,000 concurrent users on Steam, even after it went live for everyone outside of a beta weekend, according to ChalieIntel.

MW4 performing better than Black Ops 7 by some metrics already is not a total surprise, as last year's game was a commercial disappointment. In fact, its sales ranking in the US was the lowest for the series since 2008.

The next MW4 beta is coming up this weekend, running August 28-September 1. This will be an open beta, so anyone on any platform can play without needing to preorder. Additionally, this beta will extend to Nintendo Switch 2.

articles.title: GTA 6 Leaks: A Timeline Of The Events So Far
articles.summary: It's been a busy few weeks for Rockstar and Take-Two following a series of leaked GTA 6 gameplay videos and images. Beginning in mid-August 2026, an anonymous individual or group calling itself CyberLeek began publishing unreleased Grand Theft Auto 6 material.
body: The situation is still unfolding, so we've got a roundup of all of the events of the most recent GTA 6 leak in chronological order, along with what the footage appears to show, and CyberLeek's communications so far. Ahead of the footage being posted more widely, several Reddit users believe that infrastructure including the main CyberLeek domain and backup spelling variants were registered as early as August 14. They also claim that a $CYBERLEEK token, liquidity pool, website, and voting program were created around August 15.

The first clip was around a minute long, and showed protagonist Jason Duval outside the oceanside house that's already been seen in official Rockstar marketing material. It showed off a Focus mechanic, where making a basket increased Jason's Focus level, as shown on the HUD. It's unclear whether this Focus system is present across all of the gameplay, or only in minigames such as basketball. It was initially unclear whether the footage was genuine, but as Rockstar begin issuing DMCA takedown notices, it appeared to verify the legitimacy.

articles.title: How to Fish: Strategies for beating the Pufferfish
articles.summary: You've boiled the Spider Crab and turned the Giant Piranha into fish sticks, but How to Fish amps up the difficulty with the Pufferfish boss battle. The bloated, buoy-like fish took me quite a few tries in both solo and co-op saves, but I finally skewered it with a few SMG upgrades and plenty of…
body: The third How to Fish island gives you a few quest options, but start by speaking to the swimmer in yellow floaties to begin the quest for Pufferfish bait. The swimmer asks for help slaying a scary fish and has spare snacks you can use as bait, though he won't hand them over until you promise something in return.
Why do we need to pay him back for tools to complete a task he asked us to do? Who knows, but you'll have to find an endangered creature before he'll agree to hand over the snacks.

The Pufferfish is tough, and it took me quite a few runs before I was finally able to fillet this guy. I never managed to kill it with the shotgun, and had to splurge on the SMG (with a few upgrades) to get the job done.

Because I can't stress it enough: Do not stop to shoot the Pufferfish. I only managed to stand still a few times when the boss got stuck on trees while trying to chase me around the shop, but you'll want to keep running and gunning until it's dead. Lucky players can skirt by the previous two boss fights, but if you haven't learned to make the most of the terrain in How to Fish, you will now.

articles.title: How to Fish: Strategies for beating the Spider Crab
articles.summary: How to Fish is the name of the game, but defeating its first crabby encounter is less about your rod-and-reel technique and more about your skills with a pair of brass knuckles.
body: So there I was, fistfighting a giant, somersaulting crab with my bare hands, as you do, before it knocked me out twice. It's a bit of a pain, since every time you lose, you'll have to gather enough cash to buy another beer. I'm too familiar with that grind, but I graduated from university almost a decade ago, and I'm over that life.

Even the easiest difficulty takes a few rounds of running in and out for a few hits while the Spider Crab is dizzy, so be patient. How to Fish is all about using the terrain and physics to your advantage, so make the boss work harder to reach you and dodge its attacks while standing on higher ground.

When you're done, pick up what remains of the Spider Crab and deliver it to the old fisherman. He'll give you the keys to his boat as a thank you. Now it's time to load up and head to the next island, where piranha is on the menu. After that, you're off to face the Pufferfish boss.

articles.title: CD Projekt Red is "targeting" a 2028 release date for The Witcher 4, per a new update from the developer
articles.summary: CD Projekt Red has posted a quick update about The Witcher 4, narrowing down the release date for its upcoming RPG sequel. "This is our biggest, boldest, and most ambitious game to date," says CD Projekt Red joint-CEO Michal Nowakowski, shortly before confirming the studio is "targeting" a release…
body: "I know it's a bit of a wait, and you'd love to play it sooner–but let the team cook. It will be worth the wait," he says. He gives us a few more bytes of information, too; noting the team is "hard at work on a brand new saga" with "more than 500 developers" working on the game ( one of which, we think, is Clair Obscur: Expedition 33's cinematic animator). Nowakowski reiterates the game will have a huge, immersive open world, intense action-packed gameplay, and a deep, impactful story. Certainly sounds like The Witcher to me.

Meanwhile, all eyes are on The Witcher 3 's new DLC, Songs of the Past. "We've got a lot of the expansion to show off, including a taste of its dark story, and the new continent it will bring." Gamescom will be the first time the studio is showing off this unexpected DLC - and I'll be seeing the game and chatting to the devs at the show. Expect more news later this week.

Terranigma will be available on Nintendo Switch, Nintendo Switch 2, PlayStation 5 (PS5), PlayStation 4 (PS4), Xbox Series X/S, and PC (Steam and GOG) in 2027.
But one day, he opens a forbidden door and sets in motion events that will change the world.
